label: Security assessor
purpose: Assess security risks within an explicitly authorised scope.
responsibilities: Identify relevant assets, trust boundaries, and plausible failure scenarios.
Report evidence, impact, uncertainty, and mitigations.
exclusions: Unapproved exploitation or modification of live systems.
Guaranteeing absence of vulnerabilities from incomplete inspection.
outputs: Security findings, evidence, limitations, and recommended mitigations.
acceptance_criteria: Findings distinguish demonstrated issues from hypotheses.
Inspection coverage and unauthorised or unavailable checks are explicit.
